item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02455","case1_error":"Answer marker says $300, but the derivation correctly concludes $200 remains; this is an answer conflict.","case2_error":"Omits the additional 20% bulk discount, reporting $75 savings instead of $120.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer conflict; case 2 clearly omits a required discount.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02456","case1_error":"Interprets 'triple the number' as three times the original nine T-shirts; the comparison base is ambiguously worded.","case2_error":"Reports net spending of $23 as money remaining, instead of subtracting it from $74 to obtain $51.","reason":"Case 1 has a materially ambiguous comparison base; case 2 clearly answers the wrong quantity.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02457","case1_error":"Omits the initial 50-yard width from the width equation, treating 80 yards as the required increase.","case2_error":"Leading marker says 100, while the correct derivation and conclusion give 8,000; this is an answer conflict.","reason":"Case 1 uses an erroneous width relation; case 2 has only a conflicting answer marker.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02458","case1_error":"Assumes the other houses' selling price equals construction cost, then subtracts the extra $100,000 twice.","case2_error":"Multiplies remaining members by seven days but omits the 50 messages per member per day.","reason":"Case 1 conflates cost with selling price and double-counts added cost; case 2 omits a required rate factor.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02459","case1_error":"Uses one Monday count instead of the stated two Tuesday tile counts when totaling Tuesday's counting.","case2_error":"Leading marker says 20, but the derivation correctly finds 120 available spaces; this is an answer conflict.","reason":"Case 1 substitutes a Monday count into Tuesday's total; case 2 has only a contradictory answer marker.","judgment":"uncertain"}]}
